messages:
incident-bot: PAGER FIRED: P1 - deploy v2026.03.16-rc2 -> eu-west-1. Observed 5xx spike on /api/v1/generate starting 1719809950. Pager: INC12345. Tags: region:eu-west-1, release:rc2

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Triggered INC12345 - Severity: P1. Notify: @eng-oncall (auto-escalation: 10m). Link: https://pdb/INC12345

Priya SRE: Acked. I'm on call. Jumping in — what is the observed scope?

Jonah Infra: Seeing ~8% 5xx rate for eu-west-1 over the last 2m, p95 latency unchanged. Errors are 503 from runtime service (runtime-proxy). No obvious CPU/GPU saturation.

Maya Runtime: I can take runtime. Quick look at logs shows repeated KV cache errors + traceback: `kv_cache: invalid length` right before 503. Might be an interaction with the quantized kernels in rc2.

Sam Support: FYI CS inbound: two paid customers opened tickets about 503s starting ~10:06 UTC. Ticket IDs: CS-3344, CS-3349. Volume up 3x.

Priya SRE: OK. Primary mitigation options: rollback release in eu-west-1 OR divert traffic to stable pool. Which is fastest?

Jonah Infra: I can shift routing. I'll move traffic off canary to stable across eu-west-1. Command I'm running: ```./ctl route shift --region eu-west-1 --from canary --to stable --percent 100 --dry-run=false```

deploy-bot: Routing change accepted. Started shift: 50% -> 1719810140, 100% -> pending.

Maya Runtime: I attempted a hotfix patch to kv cache tonight but container restarts still produce 503s. Safe path = rollback. I'll prepare `kubectl rollout undo` on the runtime daemonset in eu-west-1.

Priya SRE: Proceed with route shift immediately and then rollback the runtime on the canary nodes. Jonah, after shift, confirm error rate across region. If errors persist after rollback escalate to EngLead.

Jonah Infra: Routing at 100% to stable now. Output: ```shift status: complete
from: canary
to: stable
region: eu-west-1
rolled: 100%
completed_at: 1719810245```

Priya SRE: Monitoring...

Maya Runtime: Undo started: `kubectl -n runtime rollout undo ds/runtime-proxy --to-revision=2026.03.15`

deploy-bot: `kubectl rollout undo` initiated on 6 pods; progress recorded.

pagerduty-bot: INC12345 acknowledged by Priya SRE at 1719810260.

Jonah Infra: Error rate dropping — eu-west-1 5xx now ~0.6% and trending to baseline. p95 latency stable.

Sam Support: CS updated customers with temporary workaround + we're tracking impacted customers. I'll escalate to account managers for the two paid customers.

Leah Product: Noted. I'll prepare a short status for PMs and CS and draft a post-incident note. Need ETA for full rollback confirmation.

Maya Runtime: All canary runtime pods rolled back successfully. Current image: v2026.03.15. Last restart at 1719810360. Logs show no kv cache errors after roll.

Priya SRE: Good. I'll keep the bridge open for 30m for monitoring, then hand off to daytime rotation. Creating incident ticket: RN-789 (root-cause tracking).

Priya SRE: Handoff: I'm off shift in 20m, handing to Jonah Infra for watch. Jonah — please own next 2h monitoring and follow up on postmortem actions: reproduce locally + test quant kernel compatibility.

Jonah Infra: Ack. I'll own monitoring and the follow-up. Setting a dashboard alert to suppress duplicate pages while we stabilize.

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigation in place (traffic diverted + runtime rollback). Status: Partial mitigation. Incident severity remains P1 until stable for 30m.

Priya SRE: Thanks team. We'll do a quick blameless postmortem. Short summary for record: release rc2 introduced a regression in runtime's interaction with quant kernels causing kv cache errors + 503s in eu-west-1. Immediate mitigation: route shift -> rollback to v2026.03.15. Impact: elevated 5xx for ~12m, two paying customers affected; no data loss. Next: reproduce, fix kernel handshake, extend canary tests.

Leah Product: I'll coordinate customer follow-ups after pm sync.

Sam Support: Marking incident resolved for CS after 60m watch and customer outreach.

incident-bot: Incident INC12345: Mitigation confirmed. Monitoring period started at 1719810480. Will auto-close if stable for 30m.

Priya SRE: Closing notes will be added to INC12345 and RN-789. If anything spikes, page back oncall. :white_check_mark:
